note: TASVIA Academy original starter practice questions for learning. These are not official NVS/AISSEE papers or reproduced previous-year questions. Confirm current official syllabus and pattern before exam.

questions.q: Which number comes next: 2, 4, 8, 16, __?
questions.explanation: Each number is doubled: 16 × 2 = 32.

questions.q: Find the odd one out.
questions.explanation: A circle has no straight sides or corners; the others are polygons.

questions.q: If CAT is coded as DBU (each letter moves one step forward), DOG is coded as:
questions.explanation: D→E, O→P and G→H.

questions.q: A is taller than B. B is taller than C. Who is shortest?
questions.explanation: The order is A > B > C, so C is shortest.

questions.q: What is 375 + 248?
A box has 8 rows of 6 pencils. How many pencils are there?
What is 3/4 of 20?
Choose the synonym of “brave”.
questions.explanation: Brave means courageous.

questions.q: Choose the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is beautiful.

questions.q: Choose the correct plural of “child”.
questions.explanation: The irregular plural of child is children.

questions.q: Solve: 3x − 5 = 16.
The area of a triangle with base 12 cm and height 5 cm is:
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × base × height = 30 cm².

questions.q: What is the simple interest on ₹2,000 at 5% per year for 2 years?
Factorise x² − 9.
questions.explanation: Difference of squares: a²−b²=(a−b)(a+b).

questions.q: Which cell organelle is the main site of aerobic respiration?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria release usable energy through aerobic respiration.

questions.q: The SI unit of electric current is:
questions.explanation: Electric current is measured in amperes (A).

questions.q: Which gas is released during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Oxygen is released when water is split during photosynthesis.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: “The boy kicked the ball.”
options: The ball was kicked by the boy.
The boy was kicked by the ball.
questions.explanation: Past simple passive uses was/were + past participle.

questions.q: Choose the antonym of “scarce”.
questions.explanation: Scarce means insufficient or rare; abundant is the opposite.

questions.q: If all roses are flowers and some flowers fade quickly, which statement must be true?
questions.explanation: Only the first premise guarantees that every rose is a flower.

packs.title: Sainik School AISSEE · Class 6 · Starter Set 1

questions.q: What is 25% of 240?
questions.explanation: 25% is one quarter; 240 ÷ 4 = 60.

questions.q: The perimeter of a square with side 9 cm is:
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 4 × side = 36 cm.

questions.q: Simplify 48 ÷ 6 + 3 × 4.
questions.explanation: Division and multiplication first: 8 + 12 = 20.

questions.q: Complete the pattern: A, C, E, G, __.
questions.explanation: The sequence skips one letter each time; next is I.

questions.q: Which is the mirror-like opposite direction of East?
questions.explanation: West is opposite East.

questions.q: Choose the noun in the sentence: “The cadet saluted smartly.”
questions.explanation: Cadet names a person and is the noun.

questions.q: Choose the correct article: “He is ___ honest boy.”
questions.explanation: Honest begins with a vowel sound, so use “an”.

questions.q: The national animal of India is the:
questions.explanation: The Bengal tiger is India's national animal.

questions.q: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Iron-rich dust gives Mars its reddish appearance.

questions.q: Which organ pumps blood through the human body?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood through the circulatory system.

packs.title: Sainik School AISSEE · Class 9 · Starter Set 1

questions.q: If 2x + 7 = 23, then x equals:
The hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs 6 cm and 8 cm is:
questions.explanation: By Pythagoras, √(36+64) = √100 = 10 cm.

questions.q: The mean of 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 is:
questions.explanation: The sum is 40; 40 ÷ 5 = 8.

questions.q: Which blood cells help defend the body against infection?
questions.explanation: White blood cells are key cells of the immune system.

questions.q: Which law states that current is directly proportional to voltage at constant temperature?
questions.explanation: Ohm’s law is V = IR for a conductor under constant physical conditions.

questions.q: Choose the correct reported speech: He said, “I am tired.”
options: He said that I am tired.
He said that he was tired.
He said that he is tiring.
questions.explanation: In reported speech, the pronoun and tense change appropriately.

questions.q: Choose the synonym of “diligent”.
questions.explanation: Diligent means showing steady, careful effort.

questions.q: The Constitution of India came into effect on:
questions.explanation: India celebrates Republic Day on 26 January, when the Constitution took effect.

questions.q: Which imaginary line divides Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres?
questions.explanation: The Equator is at 0° latitude and divides the two hemispheres.

questions.q: Find the next number: 5, 10, 20, 40, __.
questions.explanation: Each term is doubled; 40 × 2 = 80.

questions.q: Find the next number: 3, 6, 12, 24, __.
questions.explanation: Each term is multiplied by 2, so 24 × 2 = 48.

questions.q: Which pair has the same relationship as Bird : Nest?
questions.explanation: A nest is a bird's home; a hive is a bee's home.

questions.q: If yesterday was Monday, what day is tomorrow?
questions.explanation: Yesterday Monday means today Tuesday and tomorrow Wednesday.

questions.q: Choose the odd one out.
questions.explanation: Sunday is a day; the others are months.

questions.q: What is 846 − 379?
A ribbon 3 m long is cut into 6 equal pieces. Each piece is:
What is 2/5 of 35?
A book costs ₹48. What is the cost of 5 books?
Choose the antonym of “ancient”.
questions.explanation: Modern means recent or current; it is the opposite of ancient.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: With she/he/it in the simple present, the verb usually takes -s.

questions.q: Complete the series: 1, 4, 9, 16, __.
questions.explanation: These are square numbers: 1², 2², 3², 4², so next is 5² = 25.

questions.q: If SOUTH is written as TPVUI (each letter moves one step forward), EAST is written as:
questions.explanation: E→F, A→B, S→T and T→U.

questions.q: Ravi faces North and turns right. Which direction is he facing?
questions.explanation: A right turn from North points East.

questions.q: Which shape has exactly one curved boundary and no corners?
questions.explanation: A circle has one continuous curved boundary and no corners.

questions.q: What is 125 × 8?
A tank holds 750 litres. If 275 litres are used, how much remains?
Which fraction is equal to 3/6?
questions.explanation: Divide numerator and denominator by 3 to get 1/2.

questions.q: A bus travels 45 km in one hour. How far in 4 hours at the same speed?
Choose the synonym of “rapid”.
questions.explanation: Rapid means quick or fast.

questions.q: What is the past tense of “teach”?
questions.explanation: The past tense of teach is taught.

questions.q: Solve: 5x + 3 = 28.
The perimeter of a rectangle of length 12 cm and breadth 7 cm is:
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2(12 + 7) = 38 cm.

questions.q: Simplify: (−3)² + 4.
The probability of getting a head on a fair coin is:
questions.explanation: There are two equally likely outcomes; one is a head.

questions.q: Which force opposes motion between two surfaces in contact?
questions.explanation: Friction opposes relative motion between surfaces.

questions.q: The basic unit of life is the:
questions.explanation: The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of life.

questions.q: Which of these is a non-renewable source of energy?
questions.explanation: Coal forms over millions of years and is non-renewable.

questions.q: Choose the correct reported speech: He said, “I am tired.”
options: He said that I am tired.
He said that he was tired.
questions.explanation: In reported speech, am generally changes to was and I to he.

questions.q: Choose the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is environment.

questions.q: All squares are rectangles. Which statement follows?
questions.explanation: The statement directly says every square belongs to the rectangle group.

questions.q: If y/4 = 6, then y is:
questions.explanation: Multiply both sides by 4: y = 24.

questions.q: The sum of angles in a quadrilateral is:
questions.explanation: The interior angles of a quadrilateral add up to 360°.

questions.q: A shirt marked ₹800 is discounted by 10%. The sale price is:
The square root of 196 is:
Which part of a plant absorbs most water from soil?
questions.explanation: Root hairs provide a large surface area for water absorption.

questions.q: A device that converts electrical energy into light is a:
questions.explanation: A bulb converts electrical energy into light and heat.

questions.q: Which gas is essential for combustion?
questions.explanation: Oxygen supports combustion.

questions.q: Choose the antonym of “expand”.
questions.explanation: Contract means to become smaller; it is opposite to expand.

questions.q: Identify the adjective: “The clever student solved it.”
questions.explanation: Clever describes the noun student.

questions.q: Find the next term: 2, 5, 8, 11, __.
questions.explanation: Each term increases by 3; 11 + 3 = 14.

packs.title: Sainik School AISSEE · Class 6 · Practice Set 2

questions.q: A rectangle is 14 cm long and 5 cm wide. Its area is:
questions.explanation: Area = length × breadth = 14 × 5 = 70 cm².

questions.q: Find 15% of 200.
questions.explanation: 10% of 200 is 20 and 5% is 10; total 30.

questions.q: Complete the series: Z, X, V, T, __.
questions.explanation: The series moves backwards by two letters: next is R.

questions.q: Which number is the odd one out?
questions.explanation: 9, 16 and 25 are perfect squares; 30 is not.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: The book is ___ the table.
questions.explanation: On indicates that the book rests on the table's surface.

questions.q: Choose the plural of “tooth”.
questions.explanation: The irregular plural of tooth is teeth.

questions.q: Which is the largest planet in our Solar System?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.

questions.q: The Indian national flag has how many main colours in its bands?
questions.explanation: The flag has saffron, white and green bands; the Ashoka Chakra is blue.

questions.q: Which vitamin is produced in the skin in sunlight?
questions.explanation: Sunlight enables the skin to synthesize vitamin D.

packs.title: Sainik School AISSEE · Class 6 · Practice Set 3

questions.q: What is 864 ÷ 12?
The smallest prime number is:
questions.explanation: 2 is the smallest prime number and the only even prime.

questions.q: Convert 2.5 metres into centimetres.
questions.explanation: 1 metre = 100 cm, so 2.5 m = 250 cm.

questions.q: Complete the series: 4, 7, 10, 13, __.
questions.explanation: Add 3 each time; next is 16.

questions.q: If 1 January is a Monday, what day is 8 January?
questions.explanation: Seven days later is the same weekday.

questions.q: Choose the synonym of “honest”.
questions.explanation: Honest means truthful.

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: They ___ playing outside.
questions.explanation: They takes the plural verb are.

questions.q: Which city is the capital of Telangana?
questions.explanation: Hyderabad is the capital of Telangana.

questions.q: Which ocean lies to the south of India?
questions.explanation: The Indian Ocean lies south of India.

questions.q: Water changes into water vapour by:
questions.explanation: Evaporation changes liquid water into water vapour.

packs.title: Sainik School AISSEE · Class 9 · Practice Set 2

questions.explanation: Divide by 3: x − 2 = 7, so x = 9.

questions.q: The circumference of a circle of radius 7 cm (use π = 22/7) is:
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2πr = 2 × 22/7 × 7 = 44 cm.

questions.q: The value of 2³ × 2² is:
questions.explanation: For the same base, add exponents: 2^(3+2) = 2⁵.

questions.q: If a triangle has angles 50° and 60°, its third angle is:
Which instrument measures atmospheric pressure?
questions.explanation: A barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.q: The process by which plants lose water vapour through leaves is:
questions.explanation: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour from plant surfaces, especially leaves.

questions.q: Which particle has a negative electric charge?
questions.explanation: Electrons carry a negative charge.

questions.q: Choose the correct conjunction: I stayed home ___ it was raining.
questions.explanation: Because introduces the reason for staying home.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: “They will finish the work.”
options: The work will be finished by them.
The work is finished by them.
They will be finished by work.
questions.explanation: Future passive uses will be + past participle.

questions.q: Find the next number: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, __.
questions.explanation: These are consecutive squares; the next is 6² = 36.

packs.title: Sainik School AISSEE · Class 9 · Practice Set 3

questions.q: Solve: 4x − 9 = 27.
The volume of a cube with side 4 cm is:
questions.explanation: Volume = side³ = 4³ = 64 cm³.

questions.q: A sum of ₹1,500 earns 8% simple interest in one year. Interest is:
The coordinates of the origin are:
questions.explanation: The origin is the point where both axes meet: (0,0).

questions.q: Which organ filters waste from the blood to form urine?
questions.explanation: The kidneys filter blood and form urine.

questions.q: The image formed by a plane mirror is generally:
questions.explanation: A plane mirror forms a virtual, erect image of the same size.

questions.q: Which of these is a chemical change?
questions.explanation: Rusting produces a new substance, iron oxide.

questions.q: Choose the antonym of “generous”.
questions.explanation: Selfish is opposite in meaning to generous.

questions.q: Identify the adverb: “The cadet marched smartly.”
questions.explanation: Smartly describes how the cadet marched.

questions.q: If every cadet wears a uniform and Arun is a cadet, what follows?
questions.explanation: Arun belongs to the cadet group, so the rule applies to him.
